title: reading first: are the platform's own system datasets out of the vocabulary advisory's reach by design
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic). The maintainer set who files this epic's cards, in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported to this session by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6947282338, gap 3); the filer did not re-read the code behind it.

## Why

The platform ships seven dataset members with no vocabulary and its own lint says nothing about them. Either that is a deliberate exemption nobody wrote down, or the rule cannot see them.

## Evidence

- Per the report: `packages/platform-objects` `system.datasets.ts` has 7 bare members; `os lint` there reports 0 findings for `dataset-member-no-vocabulary`. Whether that is by design was not read.

## Scope

- Reading: why the rule reports nothing there. Post it on this card.
- Then one of: give the seven members vocabulary; or state the exemption where the rule lives.

## Done when

- The reading is on the card and the outcome is one of the two.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34718.
